question: A team repeatedly corrects Claude in chat because it keeps using the wrong report template. What is the most durable fix?
options: A) Keep correcting Claude in chat, since each correction improves the answers for the whole team.
B) Put the template requirement into the project instructions so every chat starts with the right rule.
C) Ask each person to paste the template into the first message of every conversation they start.
D) Create a new project each month so that the wrong template does not carry over from any earlier work.
correct_answers: B) Put the template requirement into the project instructions so every chat starts with the right rule.
explanations: A correction inside one conversation does not change the behaviour for anyone else.
Correct. Making a repeated correction part of the configuration stops the team re-solving it every time.
This keeps the manual step and simply moves it to the top of each chat.
New workspaces without the rule will still default to the wrong template.
